sources.entry: urllib3 - An HTTP library with thread-safe connection pooling, file post, and more.

summary.one_liner: urllib3 is a user-friendly HTTP client library for Python offering thread safety, connection pooling, SSL/TLS verification, multipart file uploads, retries, and proxy support.
summary.what_it_does: Provides an HTTP client for Python with features the README says are missing from the standard library: thread safety, connection pooling, client-side SSL/TLS verification, and multipart file uploads. It includes helpers for retrying requests and handling HTTP redirects. It decodes gzip, deflate, brotli, and zstd content encodings and supports HTTP and SOCKS proxies. A simple top-level request() function performs a GET or other request in one call and returns a response with status and data attributes. Usage and reference documentation is hosted on readthedocs.
use_cases: make HTTP requests from Python scripts
connection pooling for high-volume API calls
upload files with multipart form encoding
route requests through HTTP or SOCKS proxies
verify SSL/TLS certificates in client code
notable: Supports gzip, deflate, brotli, and zstd encodings
Maintained since 2008 with a lead maintainer and security-focused process
